OrganizationBusinessName.BusinessNameLine1Txt: THE INFRASTRUCTURE PAC OF THE ASSOCIATED GENERAL CONTRACTORS

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE CHAPTER IS EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL AND STATE INCOME TAXES UNDER INTERNAL REVENUE CODE (IRC) SECTION 501(C)(6) AND THE CORRESPONDING PROVISIONS OF THE CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE. THE CHAPTER IS SUBJECT TO FEDERAL AND CALIFORNIA INCOME TAXES ON UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME, AS STIPULATED IN IRC SECTION 511. FOR EACH OF THE YEARS ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024 AND 2023, TAXES ARE RECORDED WHEN PAID AND NO PROVISION FOR INCOME TAX HAS BEEN MADE. THE CHAPTER HAS NO UNRECOGNIZED TAX BENEFITS OR LIABILITIES AS OF DECEMBER 31, 2024 AND 2023. THE CHAPTER FILES AN EXEMPT RETURN IN THE UNITED STATES FEDERAL JURISDICTION AND WITH THE FRANCHISE TAX BOARD IN THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA.
RENTAL EXPENSE 412,859. UNREALIZED GAIN ON INTEREST SWAP 53,130.
VP OF GOVERNMENT RELATIONS RECEIVES BENEFIT OF HEALTH OR SOCIAL CLUB DUES. SUCH BENEFIT IS NOT INCLUDED AS COMPENSATION BECAUSE ACTIVITY IS 100% BUSINESS RELATED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 6
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE MEMBERSHIP OF THE CHAPTER SHALL INCLUDE INDIVIDUALS, SOLE PROPRIETORSHIPS, PARTNERSHIPS, CORPORATIONS, OR LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANIES WHO HAVE ESTABLISHED A REPUTATION FOR SKILL, INTEGRITY AND RESPONSIBILITY IN THEIR RESPECTIVE TRADES AND PROFESSIONS AND ARE DULY LICENSED WHEN REQUIRED BY LAW AND SHALL BE DIVIDED INTO THE FOLLOWING CLASSIFICATIONS: ACTIVE MEMBERS: "ACTIVE MEMBERS" SHALL INCLUDE GENERAL BUILDING CONTRACTORS AND GENERAL ENGINEERING CONTRACTORS AS DEFINED BY THE CALIFORNIA BUSINESS AND PROFESSIONS CODE AND CONTRACTOR MEMBERS. SPECIALTY MEMBERS: "SPECIALTY MEMBERS" SHALL INCLUDE SPECIALTY CONTRACTORS AS DEFINED BY THE CALIFORNIA BUSINESS AND PROFESSIONS CODE WHO ARE ENGAGED IN THE BUSINESS OF CONSTRUCTION CONTRACTING. CONTRACTOR MEMBERS: "CONTRACTOR MEMBERS" SHALL INCLUDE SPECIALTY CONTRACTORS WHO ALSO PARTICIPATE IN ONE OR MORE OF THE CHAPTER'S SERVICE PROGRAMS AND PAY CHAPTER DUES IN THE SAME MANNER AS GENERAL BUILDING CONTRACTOR AND GENERAL ENGINEERING CONTRACTOR MEMBERS AND SHALL BE CONSIDERED AN ACTIVE MEMBER OF THE ASSOCIATION. AFFILIATE MEMBERS: "AFFILIATE MEMBERS" SHALL INCLUDE MEMBERS WHO ARE ENGAGED PRINCIPALLY IN THE MANUFACTURE OR SALE OF MATERIALS, EQUIPMENT OR SERVICES TO CONTRACTORS. DEVELOPER MEMBERS: "DEVELOPER MEMBERS" SHALL INCLUDE MEMBERS ENGAGED IN PROPERTY DEVELOPMENT ACTIVITIES AND WHICH DO NOT PERFORM WORK AS A CONTRACTOR OR CONSTRUCTION MANAGER FOR THEMSELVES OR OTHERS. INACTIVE MEMBERS: "INACTIVE MEMBERS" SHALL INCLUDE MEMBERS NO LONGER ACTIVELY ENGAGED IN THE CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY BUT WHO, FOR A CONTINUOUS PERIOD OF TEN OR MORE YEARS, HAD BEEN A MEMBER OF THE CHAPTER IN ONE OR MORE OF THE PRECEDING CLASSIFICATIONS. EMERGING BUSINESS MEMBER: "EMERGING BUSINESS MEMBER" SHALL BE LIMITED TO FIRST TIME AGC MEMBERS WITH A MAXIMUM ANNUAL BUSINESS VOLUME NOT TO EXCEED $500,000. MEMBERSHIP IN THIS CLASSIFICATION SHALL BE FOR A MAXIMUM OF THREE YEARS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE CHAPTER'S EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE SHALL ACT AS THE NOMINATING COMMITTEE FOR CHAPTER'S BOARD OF DIRECTORS POSITIONS. ACTIVE MEMBERS AND QUALIFYING CONTRACTOR MEMBERS ELECT THE CHAPTER'S BOARD OF DIRECTORS PROPOSED BY THE NOMINATING COMMITTEE. THE CHAPTER IS A CHAPTER OF THE ASSOCIATED GENERAL CONTRACTORS OF AMERICA ("AGC NATIONAL"). THE CHAPTER SHALL APPOINT THE CHAIR OF THE AGC CONSTRUCTION LEADERSHIP COUNCIL (CLC) AS A DIRECTOR TO CHAPTER'S BOARD OF DIRECTORS. THE PRESIDENT OF ABC NATIONAL, SUBJECT TO CHAPTER'S BOARD APPROVAL, SHALL APPOINT THE CLC CHAIR WHEN THE CHAIR'S TWO YEAR TERM EXPIRES OR THE CHAIR SERVING IN THE POSITION IS UNABLE TO COMPLETE A TERM. THIS POSITION SHALL BE A VOTING POSITION, BUT THE DIRECTOR FILLING THIS POSITION SHALL NOT BE ELIGIBLE TO SERVE AS AN OFFICER OF THE CHAPTER.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: PROPOSED CHANGES TO THE BYLAWS PROVIDED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS MUST BE APPROVED BY ACTIVE MEMBERS AND CONTRACTOR MEMBERS (QUALIFYING AS ACTIVE MEMBERS).

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION'S STAFF AND AN OUTSIDE CPA FIRM PREPARE THE FORM 990. THE RETURN IS REVIEWED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS BEFORE THE FORM 990 IS SUBMITTED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTEREST ARE REVIEWED AND DETERMINED AT THE OFFICERS AND BOARD OF DIRECTORS LEVEL. IF A CONFLICT OF INTEREST IS IN EXISTENCE, IT IS REVIEWED AT THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE LEVEL. RESTRICTIONS ARE THEN IMPOSED ON SUCH PERSONS WITH A CONFLICT OF INTEREST AS NECESSARY. ANY DIRECTOR WITH A CONFLICT OF INTEREST WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO VOTE ON THE TRANSACTION. THERE WERE NO INCIDENCES OF ANY CONFLICT OF INTEREST IN 2024.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: TOTAL COMPENSATION FOR THE CEO IS PRESENTED BEFORE THE BOARD FOR APPROVAL. THE COMPENSATION FOR THE CEO IS REVIEWED AND APPROVED BY INDEPENDENT PERSONS; COMPARABILITY DATA IS USED TO DETERMINE COMPENSATION; THE APPROVAL PROCESS AND SOURCE OF COMPARABLE DATA USED FOR APPROVING COMPENSATION IS DOCUMENTED IN THE MINUTES. THIS PROCESS WAS JUST DONE DURING BUDGET COMMITTEE MEETINGS IN FEB 2022. THE ORGANIZATION HAS NO OTHER PAID DIRECTORS, OFFICERS OR KEY EMPLOYEES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION'S AUDITED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS, GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, AND CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY ARE MADE AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC UPON REQUEST.
